name: main-production-protection
description: Production branch protection: prevent accidental deletion and force push, required signatures. NOTE: `ci-required` is deliberately NOT listed as a required status check yet. Adding it is the LAST step of the CI remediation and may only be done after a reviewed canary has actually observed the `ci-required` context being published successfully on a protected-branch PR (see .kiro/specs/ci-pipeline-remediation/ROLLOUT-EVIDENCE.md). Requiring a context that no workflow can emit permanently blocks every pull request.
